text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Duramente! 
Trick or treeeeat~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Treat. 
Here, take this.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks~ ☆ 
Guess the trick'll have to wait for next time♪

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
A trick... 
Should I have chosen trick instead?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Mayano might well have had 
a trick all ready to go.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Tricks are the whole point of Halloween!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I-I wonder... 
My sister did say something similar...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm with Crown on this one! 
Tricks are part of the fun of Halloween!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
While we're at it, why don't you 
give trick-or-treating a try too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's it! If you try it yourself, 
I think you'll see the appeal of a good trick!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
A costume is essential at Halloween! 
And the deeper you get into the role, the more fun the trick!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So! From now on, Duramente, 
you shall be Count Dracula, 
and I shall be your servant!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
--Lady Duramente, as my master, 
pray observe your humble servant at work.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...So I simply follow along?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, my lady. 
But please, carry yourself with a count's dignity.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Mm... Understood.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... I've found us prey♪ 
You there. Trick or trick.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The only choice permitted to you 
is to offer your blood to Lady Duramente. 
Now, then--

text_block_list.name: Uma A
text_block_list.text:
Wha--! To Lady Duramente?! 
Y-Yes... as you wish. Eep♡

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Mm...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...All I could manage was a nod. 
Improvised acting is harder than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
But... she was having the time of her life, 
even though the trick was played on her...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Um... m-may I? 
It seems it's my turn next...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm not very good at tricks, but... 
Vivlos is always begging me to do one, 
so... I'll show you that.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Cheval told me to come to the gym 
alone, but... hm?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
What's this? There's something 
on the floor--

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
! Dark red... written in blood? 
...No, surely not.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Three steps right from here, five steps back, 
then close my eyes and press my palms together...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
H-How was that? 
I thought a surprise like this might work too... 
The trick is not letting them catch on... I think.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... Simple, but effective. 
My heart is still racing...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just like Cheval did, it helps to use 
the mood of a place like this!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And then--

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, got a chill? 
I just touched you with a cold hand.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But when you're somewhere a liiittle spooky, 
it's a trick that really gets the heart pounding!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. ...Cheval's setup, 
Kitasan's choice of place--the tricks themselves are simple. 
Even I could devise something like that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So? How was it? 
Did the fun of a good trick come through?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Let me see... Having learned about tricks from all of you, 
I believe I understand the heart of Halloween.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I find I rather want to put that learning into practice. 
Though the acting will require training.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Then why not 
try playing a trick on someone?

Duramente and the others, all in costume, 
are talking merrily in the hallway.
choice_data_list: Hey, you all look like you're having fun
Hey, you all look like you're having fun

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Good timing. 
Trick or treat?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trick, then. 
Very well--

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...No. My acting is still far from ready.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me. I will answer you 
once I have prepared a trick properly.

I never expected to hear those words from Duramente, 
but I held out the little bag of sweets 
I had prepared for today.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
-- 
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Crown was right. 
A Halloween without tricks 
might be a little lonely.
